description: The 'dss_plugins_cached' dataset provides comprehensive information about various plugins used within a data science platform. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique plugin, identified by a unique ID and a human-readable label. The dataset includes details such as the version number, author information, and a description of the plugin's functionality and use cases. It also categorizes plugins using tags, which help in filtering and searching. Additionally, the dataset tracks whether a plugin is still in development and if it is a built-in feature of the platform. Usage statistics are provided, indicating how often each plugin is utilized. The dataset also includes URLs linking to more detailed plugin summaries. This dataset is particularly useful for developers and data scientists who need to manage and track the plugins they use, ensuring they have the latest versions and understanding the capabilities and applications of each plugin. It can also aid in identifying popular plugins and those that are still under development, facilitating better project planning and resource allocation.
shortDesc: Dataset of cached plugins with details on usage and development status.
